episodes.207389: Strong low- to mid-level ridging centered over the Mid-Atlantic coast leads to stout easterly gradient and deep moisture advection over the peninsula from the Atlantic accompanied by afternoon showers and thunderstorms that produce gusty marine winds over the Cedar Key area and Tampa Bay waters.
episodes.207392: A coastal trough along the Southeast Coast led to heavy showers shifting onshore and producing flash flooding in urban areas.
episodes.207482: A large trough was situated across much of the western CONUS. This set up a potent baroclinic zone draped diagonally from the SW to the NE. Mid-level lapse rates were around 7-8 C. Bulk shear was over 40 KT with sufficient CAPE. In the late afternoon storms began to fire along the stalled boundary. These supercells primarily produced 70-81 mph winds with an additional 1 inch hail report.
episodes.207609: Thunderstorms developed along a surface trough over the western Nebraska Panhandle during the late afternoon hours of October 4th. This activity moved into the eastern Nebraska Panhandle producing strong wind gusts in Sheridan and Garden Counties. Wind gusts up to 60 MPH were reported south of Hay Springs and in the Oshkosh area. Downed power lines and tree damage was reported in Oshkosh.
episodes.208082: An upper-level trough with a period of light winds contributed to the development of strong thunderstorms across PR between October 5 and 9.
episodes.208345: A storm developed and produced a few reports of severe over Bennett county.
episodes.208461: The Grand Forks airport recorded a peak wind gust of 63 mph on Oct 5th at 1232 AM from a down burst of wind with passing thunderstorms.

At approximately 12:05 PM AST, a lightning strike occurred at Condominio San Cipriani in Carolina. A 53-year-old male was exiting his vehicle while holding an umbrella when lightning struck his left arm. The individual sustained injuries and was transported to a regional hospital, where he was reported to be in stable condition. No additional injuries or property damage were reported.

The 911 Call Center reported that a tree struck by lightning fell along Avenida Baldorioty in Carolina, just past Plaza Carolina. The fallen tree landed on a vehicle, causing a roadway obstruction. No injuries were reported.
